description: For Claude Desktop's Code tab only (where its preview tool, named like preview_start, is in your tools): adds the open-design-preview configuration to this workspace's .claude/launch.json (created if missing; other configurations are kept; only its own entry is replaced), so the Code tab can run the live browser preview in its Browser pane. Returns the configuration name and port. Then start that configuration with the Code tab's preview tool; the pane opens on the newest registered design. Call it once per project, before the first time you show a design in the Code tab, and tell the user once that you added a preview entry to .claude/launch.json. Elsewhere use open_open_design_preview.
name: set_up_open_design_browser_pane
title: Set up the browser pane
